questions.explanation: will barcha shaxsga bir xil: I'll go, she'll go.

questions.text: Telefon jiringladi — «I'll answer it» — bu qaysi ma'no?
questions.explanation: Qaror oldin qabul qilingan bo'lsa → going to; hozir qabul qilinsa → will.

questions.text: Va'da, taklif va iltimos uchun qaysi shakl ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: I'll help you (va'da), Will you help me? (iltimos).
Talaffuz farqi ma'noni butunlay o'zgartiradi.
Jadval kelajagi Present Simple bilan beriladi.
How/What about + V-ing. Solishtiring: Let's + V1, Why don't we + V1.
Rozilik: Sure! I'd love to. Sounds good! Count me in.

questions.text: Muloyim rad etish uchun eng yaxshi ibora qaysi?
questions.explanation: Sorry, I can't make it. Maybe another time.
Can we reschedule? Can we make it later?

questions.text: Kelishilgan uchrashuv haqida gapirganda qaysi shakl ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Uchrashuv → PC; niyat → going to; shu damdagi taklif → will/shall.
2 bo'g'inli -y: y → -ier (easy → easier).
Irregular: good→better, bad→worse, far→further, little→less.
Yo -er, yo more — ikkalasi birga kelmaydi.

questions.text: Qiyosiy darajani kuchaytirish uchun nima ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: «very bigger» xato; «much bigger» to'g'ri.
the same AS, different FROM, similar TO — predlogi bilan yodlang.

questions.text: Orttirma daraja qaysi artikl bilan keladi?
questions.explanation: Doim «the»: the tallest, the most expensive.

options: Ikki marta orttirma — faqat the tallest
questions.explanation: Yo -est, yo the most — birga kelmaydi.
in — joy/guruh bilan; of — ko'plik yoki davr bilan (the best of my life).

questions.text: «one of the best ___ » — bo'shliqqa qaysi shakl?
questions.explanation: one of the + superlative + KO'PLIK ot.
Irregular: the best, the worst, the furthest, the least.

questions.text: «I ___ go to school» (always) — ravish qayerga qo'yiladi?
questions.explanation: I always go to school.
to be dan keyin: I am always busy. She is never late.
I have never been. You can always call.

questions.text: «I don't never go» — bu nega xato?
options: never o'zi inkor — don't bilan ishlatilmaydi
questions.explanation: To'g'risi: I never go.

options: every day — ravish (har kuni); everyday — sifat (kundalik)
questions.explanation: Aniq takror gap oxirida: every day, once a week, twice a month.
Xavfli sanalmaydigan otlar: information, advice, news, furniture, money, work, luggage, homework.
much → sanalmaydigan; many → sanaladigan; a lot of → ikkalasi (ijobiy).

options: a few — bir oz (ijobiy); few — kam (salbiy)
questions.explanation: Xuddi shunday: a little (bir oz) ↔ little (kam).
a piece of advice/information/furniture; a glass of water; a slice of bread.
fewer books, less water.

questions.text: «___ books do you have?» — bo'shliqqa nima?
questions.explanation: how many — sanaladigan; how much — sanalmaydigan (va narx).
It's too hot (chidab bo'lmaydi) ≠ It's very hot (juda issiq).
Sifat/ravish bilan esa KEYIN: big enough, fast enough.

questions.text: «He is ___ to drive» (yoshi yetarli) — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: old enough TO drive; too tired TO work.
«gh» bu yerda /f/ deb o'qiladi.
